import pyaudio
from google.cloud import speech_v1p1beta1 as speech
from google.api_core.exceptions import GoogleAPIError

from speech_client import get_speech_client
from speech_models import StreamingRecognitionConfig, StreamingRecognitionResponse

def stream_microphone_audio(
    rate: int = 16000,
    chunk_size: int = 1024
) -> StreamingRecognitionResponse:
    """Streams audio from the microphone and yields interim transcripts."""

    client = get_speech_client()

    audio_config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
        sample_rate_hertz=rate,
        language_code="en-US",
    )
    streaming_config = StreamingRecognitionConfig(config=audio_config, interim_results=True)

    mic_audio = pyaudio.PyAudio()
    mic_stream = mic_audio.open(
        format=pyaudio.paInt16,
        channels=1,
        rate=rate,
        input=True,
        frames_per_buffer=chunk_size
    )

    def generate_requests():
        yield streaming_config.to_proto()
        while True:
            chunk = mic_stream.read(chunk_size)
            yield speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=chunk)

    try:
        responses = client.streaming_recognize(generate_requests())
        for response in responses:
            yield StreamingRecognitionResponse.from_proto(response)
    except GoogleAPIError as e:
        print(f"Google Cloud Speech-to-Text API Error: {e}")
    finally:
        mic_stream.stop_stream()
        mic_stream.close()
        mic_audio.terminate()

from google.cloud import translate_v3 as translate
import os

def translate_caption(
    text: str,
    target_language_code: str = "es",
    project_id: str = os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT", "your-gcp-project-id")
) -> str:
    """Translates live captions into another language using Google Cloud Translation."""

    client = translate.TranslationServiceClient()

    location = "global"
\    parent = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}"

    response = client.translate_text(
        request={
            "parent": parent,
            "contents": [text],
            "mime_type": "text/plain",  # Mime types: "text/plain" or "text/html"
            "target_language_code": target_language_code,
        }
    )

    if response.translations:
        return response.translations[0].translated_text
    return text

import os
import vertexai
from vertexai.preview.generative_models import GenerativeModel, Part, Image

def summarize_meeting_transcript(
    transcript_chunks: list[str],
    project_id: str = os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT", "your-gcp-project-id"),
    location: str = "us-central1"
) -> str:
    """Summarizes live meeting transcript chunks using Google's Generative AI (Vertex AI)."""

    vertexai.init(project=project_id, location=location)
    model = GenerativeModel("gemini-pro") # Using gemini-pro for text summarization

    full_transcript = "\n".join(transcript_chunks)

    prompt = f"""Summarize the following meeting transcript:

{full_transcript}

Summary:"""

    response = model.generate_content(prompt)
    return response.text

import os
import vertexai
from vertexai.language_models import TextEmbeddingModel

def embed_caption_chunk(
    text_chunk: str,
    project_id: str = os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT", "your-gcp-project-id"),
    location: str = "us-central1"
) -> list[float]:
    """Embeds caption chunks for semantic meeting search using Google's Generative AI (Vertex AI)."""

    vertexai.init(project=project_id, location=location)
    model = TextEmbeddingModel.from_pretrained("textembedding-gecko@003")

    embeddings = model.get_embeddings([text_chunk])
    return embeddings[0].values
